title: Response profile matrix: per-model & per-route p50/p95/p99 with streaming vs blocking split
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build a consolidated "response profile matrix" dashboard that surfaces percentile latency (p50/p95/p99) across models and routes, broken down by IO mode (streaming vs blocking/non-streaming). This dashboard should let SREs and platform engineers quickly identify regressions that are specific to streaming behavior, model variants, or route-level config. Deliverables: panel matrix heatmap, per-route sparklines, io-mode delta bars, trace links to Zipkin/Jaeger, and pre-built PromQL/TSQL queries for the metrics pipeline. The view must support time-shift comparison, deployment annotations, and exportable CSV of selected cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix view shows models as rows and routes as columns with p50/p95/p99 selectable
Toggle to compare streaming vs blocking for any cell and surface absolute + relative delta
Each cell links to a pre-filtered trace search that includes trace_id, request_shape, and sampling hints
Prometheus/metrics queries and logs index queries are documented in the dashboard help panel
Alerts and baseline regressions can be anchored to any matrix cell and mapped back to existing SLOs
work_notes: 2025-02-06: Kickoff meeting — scoped MVP to heatmap + per-route sparkline + trace links. Attendees: Aisha, Carlos, Elena (product), Max (observability infra).

2025-02-08: Decided to reuse existing percentile buckets emitted by runtime (histogram_quantile) to avoid client-side aggregation costs; agreed to add smaller sample-based streaming-specific histogram if needed.

2025-02-11: Infra will expose two metric labels: io_mode={streaming,blocking} and serve_path (model:route). Metric owners: observability-team. Follow-up task created to add io_mode to all route emitters (ENG-49321).
2025-02-14: Implemented initial PromQL drafts and Kibana saved searches. Draft dashboard pinned at https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/preview/response-profile-matrix (temp).
2025-02-18: Design feedback from Elena: add colorblind-friendly palette and vertical cell hover to show sample counts and recent deploy tag. Action: DES-312 -> design to provide palette and hover UX.

2025-02-19: Discovered high cardinality for serve_path when customers use tenant prefixes. Trade-off: aggregate by route base (strip tenant) for dashboard while preserving raw label in traces/logs. Implemented aggregation in metrics pipeline; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/912
2025-02-20: Integration test notes — dashboard loads within 2s for top 50 models, sampling fallback enabled for >10k unique routes. Next: add alert playbook and SLO mapping.
technical_notes: PromQL examples: p95 = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="runtime",io_mode=~"streaming|blocking"}[5m])) by (le, model, route, io_mode))
Trace hook: ensure runtime attaches trace_id and io_mode tag to root span; link format is /traces?trace_id={trace_id}&filter=serve_path:{route}
Logs: new index pattern observability-requests-* with fields serve_path, model_version, io_mode, request_shape, sample_rate
Cardinality mitigation: add pipeline step to map tenant-prefixed routes to route_base using regex and store original_route in logs only
Dashboard panels: matrix heatmap (p95 default), cell detail flyout with percentiles and sample histogram, row-level sparklines, io-mode delta grouped bar, trace link button, export CSV
release_notes: Added response profile matrix to console > Performance > Latency. Shows p50/p95/p99 split by streaming vs blocking and per-model/per-route breakdown.
Initial rollout gated to internal orgs; will enable for beta customers after 2 weeks of monitoring.
post_deployment_checks: Verify heatmap sample counts match Prometheus cardinality expectations
Confirm trace links open pre-filtered traces and include io_mode metadata
Run load test: dashboard should render matrix for top 100 models within 3s
